ICS 29.120.40, 29.120.50ETD 07Revised Standard from Last Update.1. Scope1.1 This standard covers requirement for composite units of air-break switches and rewirable type electric fuses with rated current not exceeding 100A intended for system voltages not exceeding 650 V a.c.1.2 The switches incorporated in the composite units are intended for utilization category of AC-21A (frequent operation) and AC-21B (infrequent operation),1.3 The rewirable type fuses, incorporated in composite units, shall conform to the requirements laid down in IS 2086 : 1993.NOTES1 It shall however be recognized that this imposes no restriction on rewirable type fuse-combination of other categories of duties or composite units incorporating cartridge type fuses inwhich case reference shall be made to IS/IEC 60947 (Part 3).2 This standard shall cover only composite units incorporating:a) Air-break ‘on’ and ‘off ’ switches of category AC-21A and AC-21B and for rated current not exceeding 100A,b) Rewirable type of fuses only, andc) Enclosure of metal-clad insulated types2. References2.1 The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editionsindicated were valid.
